Plumbing renovation in Vancouver costs $1,500 to $35,000 or more in 2026, depending entirely on what the job requires. A simple rough-in for a new bathroom adds $1,500–$4,000 to your project. A full repipe of a 1970s Kerrisdale home runs $12,000–$20,000. A heat pump water heater replacement with gas line rerouting can hit $8,500 installed. This guide gives you Vancouver-specific numbers so you can budget accurately before signing a contract.

Reno Stars is a licensed Metro Vancouver plumbing and renovation contractor. Every plumbing scope we price includes a written scope, fixed-price contract, BC permit handling where required, $5M commercial general liability insurance, and a 3-year workmanship warranty. We serve Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, North Vancouver, Coquitlam, Delta, and all other Metro Vancouver cities.

What Drives Plumbing Renovation Cost in Vancouver

Three factors determine your plumbing cost: pipe age and material, scope of work, and whether the job requires a City of Vancouver or municipal permit. Metro Vancouver homes built before 1990 often have galvanized steel or even cast-iron drain lines that corrode internally over decades. When we open a wall in a 1980s Richmond townhouse and find black rust flaking off the inside of a drain pipe, replacement is not optional — it is a health and insurance issue.

Cost DriverWhy It MattersTypical Cost Impact
Galvanized steel or cast-iron pipes (pre-1990)Internal corrosion narrows the bore; restrictor valves and low pressure result. Cannot be relined reliably.+$6,000–$18,000 vs modern PEX/ABS
Drain line scope — moving or extendingDrain lines require fall (1/4" per foot minimum); concrete slab homes require jackhammering and concrete reinstatement.+$2,000–$8,000 per fixture relocated
Water main replacement (shared with city side)City of Vancouver requires licensed plumber to test and certify the tap connection; this portion is billed separately by the city.$800–$3,000 city side; $3,000–$8,000 private side
Gas line work (water heater, furnace, range)Gas work requires a registered gas contractor and inspection by Technical Safety BC. Cannot be done by a standard plumber.+$1,500–$5,000
Strata approval (condos and townhouses)Any work affecting shared plumbing in a strata building requires strata council approval — typically 2–4 weeks.+$500–$1,500 in application time

Plumbing Renovation Cost by Scope (2026)

Plumbing is rarely a standalone line item on a renovation invoice. It is usually one trade within a larger bathroom, kitchen, or basement project. The numbers below are what you should budget for the plumbing component specifically.

Bathroom vs. Kitchen vs. Basement — Plumbing Cost Comparison

The most common question we get is: how does plumbing cost compare across project types? The short answer is that kitchens are relatively plumbing-light (sink and dishwasher rough-in is typically $800–$2,500), while bathrooms carry the full load (toilet, sink, tub or shower, and vent). Basements add a premium when below-grade because drain lines may require a backwater valve or ejector pump.

Does Vancouver Require a Permit for Plumbing Work?

Yes. The City of Vancouver requires a plumbing permit for any work that adds, removes, or modifies a drain line, water service, or fixture connection. A simple vanity replacement where the drain and supply lines do not move does not require a permit. Moving a toilet, adding a second bathroom, or replacing a water main does.

The permit cost from the City of Vancouver for residential plumbing is typically $150–$500 depending on the scope. This is not the fee for the plumber's work — it is the city permit fee, passed through at cost. If your renovation involves a legal secondary suite in the basement, the plumbing permit is part of the larger building permit package, which also covers structural, electrical, and fire separation requirements.

Strata buildings add a separate approval step. Before we start any plumbing work in a Richmond, Burnaby, or Vancouver condo or townhouse, we submit a package to the strata council that includes scope of work, insurance certificates, and a noise and disruption plan. This approval typically takes 2–4 weeks and must be obtained before the city permit is applied for.

How Long Does Plumbing Renovation Take in Vancouver

A rough-in for a new bathroom in a Richmond single-family home typically takes 3–5 working days for the plumbing trade. A full repipe of a whole house takes 5–10 working days depending on whether the home is occupied and whether concrete coring is required. These timings are for the plumbing work alone — they do not include the finishing trades (tiling, painting, etc.) that follow.

Plumbing ScopeTypical Duration (Plumbing Trade Only)Notes

Bathroom rough-in (toilet + sink + shower)3–5 daysIncludes pressure test and city inspection
Partial repipe (one bathroom + kitchen)4–7 daysWall-open scope; involves patching
Whole-house repipe (3-bathroom home)7–14 daysCoordinated with other trades

How to Budget for Plumbing in Your Renovation

Start with the total project budget and allocate a plumbing reserve based on the age of your home. If your Vancouver home was built before 1985, assume at minimum a partial pipe replacement even if your plan does not change any fixture locations. Galvanized steel supply pipes have a useful life of approximately 40–50 years; past that point, pinhole leaks and low pressure become a recurring problem regardless of what else you renovate.

When you receive a fixed-price quote from a plumbing contractor, confirm it covers the city permit fee, the Technical Safety BC gas inspection (if applicable), and concrete reinstatement if coring or breaking is required. Some contractors quote the labour and materials only and pass these additional costs as extras.

At Reno Stars, every plumbing quote we provide is an all-inclusive fixed price. It covers the permit fee, city inspection, and concrete patching. We do not add extras on the day of completion. If we discover unexpected pipe deterioration during demolition, we photograph it, show you the images, and provide a written change order before proceeding.

Frequently Asked Questions — Plumbing Renovation Vancouver

How much does it cost to move a toilet in Vancouver?

Moving a toilet in Vancouver costs $2,500–$8,000 in plumbing alone. The drain line must maintain a minimum fall of 1/4 inch per foot, and in a concrete slab home, moving the drain requires concrete coring,一个新的地板防水, and city inspection. This cost does not include tiling, flooring, or fixture replacement — only the plumbing scope. Ask Reno Stars for a toilet relocation quote →

Does homeowners insurance cover plumbing replacement in Vancouver?

Standard Vancouver homeowner's insurance covers sudden and accidental water damage (a burst pipe that floods your home) but does not cover gradual deterioration or wear-and-tear on aging pipes. If galvanized pipes are 40 years old and corroded, that is maintenance — not an insurable event. Some insurers in BC now offer endorsement riders for old pipe replacement; check with your provider. Reno Stars does not handle insurance claims directly but can provide itemized invoices suitable for submission.

Can I do plumbing work without a permit in Vancouver?

No — not for any work that modifies drain lines, water supply lines, or gas connections. The City of Vancouver plumbing bylaw requires a permit for any new fixture connection, any drain modification, and any gas line work. Doing this work without a permit can void your home warranty, create issues during resale, and expose you to liability if a future water loss is investigated. Always hire a licensed plumber who pulls their own permits.

What is the difference between PEX and copper plumbing?

PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) is the standard for residential supply lines in Vancouver today. It costs approximately 30–40% less than copper, installs faster because it bends around corners without fittings, and does not corrode. PEX has been used in Metro Vancouver residential construction since the early 2000s. Copper is still used for certain exposed applications (visible risers, heritage fixtures) and for drain lines in some contexts. Reno Stars uses PEX for all residential supply re-piping unless a building code provision requires otherwise.

How long does a whole-house repipe take in Vancouver?

A whole-house repipe for a typical Vancouver single-family home (3 bathrooms, kitchen, laundry) takes 7–14 working days for the plumbing trade. This includes wall-open repiping of all supply lines, drain line replacement, pressure testing, city inspection, and wall patching coordination with the drywall contractor. The project is done while the home is occupied; we do not require the family to leave. Contact Reno Stars for a repipe assessment →

浴室 vs. 厨房 vs. 地下室——水管费用对比

我们最常被问到的问题之一是：不同项目类型的水管费用如何比较？简单回答是：厨房水管工程量相对较小（洗手台和洗碗机管道预装通常为800至2,500加元），而浴室则承担全部工程量（马桶、洗手台、浴缸或淋浴及排气管）。地下室当涉及低于地面时因排水管可能需要安装污水提升泵或防回流阀而额外增加费用。

温哥华水管工程需要许可证吗？

需要。温哥华市政府要求对任何新增、拆除或修改排水管、进水管或装置连接的工程申请水管许可证。不移动排水管和供水管的简单洗手台更换不需要许可证。但移动马桶、新增第二间浴室或更换进水管则需要。

温哥华市住宅水管许可证费用通常为150至500加元，具体取决于工程范围。这不是水管工的人工费——而是市政府许可证费用，按成本代收。如果您的装修涉及地下室合法套房， 水管许可证属于更大的建筑许可包的一部分，同时也涵盖结构、电气和防火隔离要求。

共管建筑有单独的审批步骤。在列治文、本拿比或温哥华的公寓或联排别墅开始任何水管工程之前，我们向物业管理委员会提交工程范围、保险证书和噪音及干扰计划包。此审批通常需要2至4周，且必须在申请市政府许可证之前完成。

温哥华水管改造需要多长时间

列治文独立屋新浴室管道预装工程，水管工施工通常需要3至5个工作日。全屋换管工程需要5至10个工作日，具体取决于房屋是否有人居住以及是否需要混凝土钻孔。这些时间仅指水管工施工部分——不包括后续的装修工种（贴砖、涂漆等）。

如何为装修项目中的水管工程做预算

从总项目预算开始，根据房屋年龄分配水管备用金。如果您的温哥华房屋建于1985年之前，即使您的计划不改变任何装置位置，也应至少假设需要进行部分管道更换。镀锌钢管的使用寿命约为40至50年；超过该年限后，无论您进行其他什么装修，滴漏和水压低问题都会反复出现。

从水管承包商处收到固定价格报价时，请确认其包含市政府许可证费用、Technical Safety BC燃气检查（如适用），以及如有钻孔或破除混凝土时的混凝土恢复费用。一些承包商仅报价人工和材料，将这些额外费用作为附加项目。

常见问题——温哥华水管改造

在温哥华移动马桶需要多少费用？

在温哥华移动马桶，水管工程费用为2,500至8,000加元。排水管必须保持每英尺最低1/4英寸的坡度，在混凝土地板房屋中，移动排水管需要进行混凝土钻孔、新防水层和市政检查。该费用不含贴砖、地板或装置更换——仅指水管工程范围。向Reno Stars咨询马桶移位报价 →

温哥华业主保险是否覆盖水管更换？

温哥华标准房屋保险覆盖突发和意外水损（爆管导致家中被淹），但不承保渐进性恶化或管道老化的磨损。如果镀锌管已使用40年且已腐蚀，那是维护问题——不在保险覆盖范围内。BC省部分保险公司现在提供旧管道更换的附加条款；请咨询您的提供商。Reno Stars不直接处理保险索赔，但可提供适合提交的逐项发票。

在温哥华没有许可证可以进行水管工程吗？

不可以——对于任何修改排水管、进水管或燃气连接的工程均不可。温哥华市水管条例要求对新装置连接、任何排水管修改和任何燃气管道工程申请许可证。无证施工可能导致房屋保修失效、转售时出现问题，并在未来发生水损时产生责任。请务必雇用自行申请许可证的持证水管工。

PEX管和铜管有什么区别？

PEX（交联聚乙烯）是目前温哥华住宅供水管的标准材料。相比铜管，PEX成本低约30至40%，安装更快（可弯曲绕过角落无需管件），且不腐蚀。PEX自2000年代初起在大温住宅建设中广泛使用。铜管仍用于某些明装应用（可见立管、复古装置）和某些情况下的排水管。Reno Stars对所有住宅供水管更换使用PEX，除非建筑规范另有要求。

温哥华全屋换管需要多长时间？

典型温哥华独立屋（三间浴室、厨房、洗衣房）全屋换管，水管工施工需要7至14个工作日。包括全部供水管墙体打开换管、排水管更换、压力测试、市政检查，以及与干墙承包商协调修补。施工期间家庭无需搬出。联系Reno Stars进行换管评估 →

localizations.contentJa:
2026年のバンクーバーでの配管リノ베ーション費用は、範囲に応じて1,500カナダドルから35,000カナダドル以上です。新しいバスの配管下地工事は1,500〜4,000ドル、主、配管全体を交換する費用は12,000〜20,000ドルです。熱泵湯沸かし器の交換にはガス管の再配線を含めて最大8,500ドル（含設置）となります。このガイドでは、温哥华pecificな価格情報为您提供し、契約書に署名する前に正確な予算を立てられるようにします。

Reno Starsは、メトロバンクーバーでlicensedな配管・改建業者です。すべての配管工事には、書面による範囲、固定価格契約、BC許可の取り扱い（該当する場合）、500万カナダドル商用一般責任保険、3年保証が含まれています。バンクーバー、リッチモンド、バーナビー、ノースバンクーバー、コキットラム、デルタ、メトロバンクーバーの他のすべての都市に対応しています。
localizations.contentKo:
2026년 밴쿠버 배관 리노베이션 비용은 범위에 따라 1,500달러에서 35,000달러 이상입니다. 새로운 욕실 배관 하자를하려면 1,500~4,000달러, 1970년대 주택 전체 배관 교체는 12,000~20,000달러, 열펌프 온수기 교체에 가스 배관 재배치를 포함하면 최대 8,500달러(설치 포함)입니다. 이 가이드에서는 밴쿠버Specific한 가격 정보를 제공하여 계약서에 서명하기 전에 정확한 예산을 수립할 수 있도록 합니다.

Reno Stars는 메트로 밴쿠버에서 면허를 가진 배관 및 리노베이션 계약자입니다. 당사가 제공하는 모든 배관 범위에는 서면 범위, 고정 가격 계약, 해당 시 BC 허가 처리, 5M 상업 일반 책임 보험, 3년 시공 보증이 포함됩니다. 밴쿠버, 리치몬드, 버너비, 노스 밴쿠버, 코퀴틀럼, 델타 및 모든 메트로 밴쿠버 도시를 서비스합니다.
localizations.contentVi:
Chi phí cải tạo hệ thống ống nước tại Vancouver năm 2026 dao động từ 1.500 đến 35.000 đô la hoặc hơn, tùy thuộc vào phạm vi công việc. Phần thô ống nước cho phòng tắm mới có chi phí từ 1.500 đến 4.000 đô la. Thay thế toàn bộ đường ống trong nhà từ những năm 1970 có chi phí từ 12.000 đến 20.000 đô la. Máy nước nóng bơm nhiệt thay thế với định tuyến lại đường ống gas có thể lên tới 8.500 đô la (đã lắp đặt). Hướng dẫn này cung cấp cho bạn các con số cụ thể tại Vancouver để bạn có thể lập ngân sách chính xác trước khi ký hợp đồng.

Reno Stars là nhà thầu ống nước và cải tạo được cấp phép tại Vancouver. Mọi phạm vi ống nước chúng tôi báo giá đều bao gồm phạm vi bằng văn bản, hợp đồng giá cố định, xử lý giấy phép BC khi cần, bảo hiểm trách nhiệm thương mại chung 5M và bảo hành chất lượng 3 năm. Chúng tôi phục vụ Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, North Vancouver, Coquitlam, Delta và tất cả các thành phố Metro Vancouver khác.
localizations.contentTl:
Ang plumbing renovation sa Vancouver ay nagkakahalaga ng $1,500 hanggang $35,000+ noong 2026, depende sa saklaw ng trabaho. Ang rough-in para sa bagong banyo ay nagdaragdag ng $1,500–$4,000. Ang full repipe ng isang bahay noong 1970s ay umaabot ng $12,000–$20,000. Ang heat pump water heater replacement na may gas line rerouting ay maaaring umabot ng $8,500 installed. Ang gabay na ito ay nagbibigay sa iyo ng Vancouver-specific na mga numero para magbudget nang wasto bago pumirma ng kontrata.

Ang Reno Stars ay isang licensed na Metro Vancouver plumbing at renovation contractor. Ang bawat plumbing scope na ine-price namin ay may kasamang written scope, fixed-price contract, BC permit handling kung kinakailangan, $5M commercial general liability insurance, at 3-year workmanship warranty. Nagse-serve kami sa Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, North Vancouver, Coquitlam, Delta, at lahat ng ibang Metro Vancouver na lungsod.
